title: Jazzy Argentinian Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy bowl filled with the essence of Argentina, featuring jazzy spices and a tangy sour kick.

ingredients.name: Sour Cream
ingredients.notes: Sour cream adds a tangy kick

ingredients.name: Argentinian Rice
ingredients.notes: Short-grain rice commonly used in Argentina

ingredients.name: Chopped Parsley
ingredients.notes: Fresh parsley adds a bright, fresh flavor

instructions: Cook the Argentinian rice according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the jazzy spices over medium heat for 1-2 minutes.
Add the sour cream to the pan and stir until combined with the jazzy spices.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, mixed greens, and parsley.
Pour the jazzy sour cream mixture over the top of the rice mixture.
